title: Semantic Change Snippet v1
description: Content-light, anonymized representation of a code change that preserves change intent and structure without exporting raw source code, identifiers, literals, comments, secrets, or file contents. Designed for evals, reports, and orchestration analysis.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of snippet creation.

source_event_id.description: Optional source coordination event ID that triggered this snippet.

source_artifact_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the source artifact (write_file, search_replace, checkpoint) if available.

language.description: Programming language of the changed code (python, json, markdown, shell, etc.).

repo_area_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the coarse repo area (e.g. scripts/, tests/, vibe/core/tools/). Content-light — no raw path.

path_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the file path. Content-light — no raw path.

change_kind.description: High-level classification of the change intent.

operation.description: Structural operation that produced the change.

symbol_kind.description: Kind of symbol that was changed.

symbol_hash.description: Stable SHA256 hash of the anonymized symbol name (e.g. hash of FN_001).

before_shape_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the shape before the change (anonymized-only structure).

after_shape_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the shape after the change (anonymized-only structure).

snippet_lines.description: Anonymized snippet lines showing the change shape. Identifiers replaced with stable placeholders, literals stripped, comments removed.

semantic_labels.description: Semantic tags for the change (e.g. dirty_file_guard, fail_closed, mutation_safety, schema_validation, content_light).

safety_labels.description: Safety classification tags (e.g. mutation_class, determinism_class, privacy_class).

added_line_count.description: Number of lines added in the change.

removed_line_count.description: Number of lines removed in the change.

privacy_class.description: Privacy classification — always content_light for exported snippets.

redaction_level.description: Level of redaction applied to the snippet.

forbidden_content_detected.description: True if the source contained forbidden content (secrets, raw diffs, etc.) and was excluded.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about snippet completeness or redaction quality.
